description: This file defines the DeleteThing class, which represents a command to delete a 'Thing' in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances from JSON, accessing the thing ID, and serialization. It also contains metadata annotations and implements relevant interfaces for command handling.

classes.name: DeleteThing
classes.description: A command class to delete a specified 'Thing' identified by its ThingId. It extends AbstractCommand and implements ThingModifyCommand, providing methods for JSON serialization/deserialization, header management, and identifying the command type.

methods.name: DeleteThing.of
methods.description: Creates a DeleteThing command with the provided ThingId and headers.

methods.name: DeleteThing.fromJson
methods.description: Creates a DeleteThing command from a JSON string or object, parsing the necessary fields.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the Thing to be deleted.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance of DeleteThing with updated DittoHeaders.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Indicates whether this command changes authorization; returns true.
